<!--
  One customer quote of TestimonialGrid: a card, a plain figure or a social post, with the author's picture, the
  stars and a company glyph as `item` says.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Quote, QuoteLabels, QuoteItem } from "../blocks/testimonial-grid.types";

export type QuoteCardProps = {
  q: Quote;
  labels: QuoteLabels;
  item?: QuoteItem;
  layout?: "grid" | "single" | "stack" | "masonry" | "strip";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import Rating from "../components/rating.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const { q, labels, item, layout = "grid" } = defineProps<QuoteCardProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="figure"
    :class="cn(
      'm-0 flex flex-col gap-4',
      ((item?.kind === 'plain') ? '' : 'rounded p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border bg-card'),
      (
        (layout as string) === 'masonry' ? 'mb-4 break-inside-avoid'
        : (layout as string) === 'strip' ? 'w-80 shrink-0 snap-start'
        : 'h-full'
      )
    )"
    data-testid="item"
  >
    <template v-if="(item?.kind === 'social')">
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <MediaFrame
          v-if="(item?.avatar !== 'none')"
          :alt="q.author"
          ratio="1/1"
          class="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-full"
        />
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ q.author }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(labels.handleLine, q.handle, q.time) }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <LucideIcon name="message-circle" :size="16" class="ml-auto text-muted-foreground" />
      </Group>
      <Text size="base">
        {{ q.quote }}
      </Text>
    </template>
    <template v-else>
      <Rating v-if="(item?.rating !== 'hide')" :value="q.rating" :label="tpl(labels.rating, q.rating)" :size="16" />
      <Inline v-if="(item?.mark === 'icon')" class="text-muted-foreground" data-testid="mark">
        <LucideIcon :name="q.mark" :size="24" />
      </Inline>
      <Text :size="(((layout as string) === 'single') ? 'xl' : 'base')">
        {{ q.quote }}
      </Text>
      <Group gap="4" align="center">
        <MediaFrame
          v-if="(item?.avatar !== 'none')"
          :alt="q.author"
          ratio="1/1"
          class="size-12 shrink-0 rounded-full"
        />
        <Stack gap="0">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ q.author }}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ tpl(labels.byLine, q.role, q.company) }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    </template>
  </Block>
</template>
